factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights state capex increased 57.9% to EUR 37,458 thousand (EUR 37.5 million). Capital investments section details spectrum licenses and IT/digital infrastructure as major drivers.

factual_claims.claim: In June, the company acquired two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for nearly EUR 8 million, securing 40 MHz dedicated to 5G enhancement, and paid EUR 2 million to extend rights to the 2,100 MHz band.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Capital investments section confirms acquisition of two 1,500 MHz blocks for 'almost EUR 8 million'... securing '40 MHz' for 5G, and extension of 2,100 MHz rights for EUR 2 million.

factual_claims.claim: Ongoing investments fund 50 new mobile base stations, modernization of 300 sites, and radio upgrades at approximately 130 locations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO comment states planned investment of EUR 7.1 million in 2026 will fund 'construction of 50 new base stations, the modernization of 300 existing sites and the upgrade of around 130 additional locations.'

factual_claims.claim: By mid-year, the fiber-optic network passed 992 thousand households, covering 56.4 percent of national residential potential.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Capital investments section states 'By the end of June 2026, the Company had 992 thousand households passed... by the fiber-optic network, or 56.4 per cent of the country’s households.'

factual_claims.claim: Construction also began on a new Tier III data center near Vilnius, with planned investments of EUR 26 million for initial modules expected by late 2027.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Plans and forecasts section states 'In 2026, Telia Lietuva commenced construction of a new data center near Vilnius... The Company plans to invest up to EUR 26 million to two initial data center modules with 400 racks to be completed by the second half of 2027.'

factual_claims.claim: Executive appointments, including Andreas Ekström joining the Board and Vaidas Dominauskas assuming the role of Head of Enterprise, aligned leadership structures with these sustained infrastructure and commercial targets.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Corporate governance section notes Andreas Ekström joined the Board on 24 April 2026. Management team section states Vaidas Dominauskas was appointed Head of Enterprise on 1 July 2026.
